UP Police Constable DV / PST Admit Card 2026

Post Date: August 11, 2026

12:07 pm

Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB), has released the DV / PST Admit Card on its official website for the recruitment of UP Police Constable Posts. The DV / PST will be start on 17 August 2026, The UPPRPB application process started on 31 December 2025, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 30 January 2026. Candidates will able to check their DV / PST Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link will provided below.
